group_targeting_validity_conciseness: Source8 and receiver6 give a concrete unit misbinding. Other white base squares share the receiver height and hence side; no need to mark them. Two local edge marks are concise. Color is not an equality relation and cannot erase the visible unequal sizes or change gray membership.
old_objection_resolution: Old screen rejected a direct explicit false equal-side relation or whole-family matching. This design uses no equality glyph and only open source/receiver segments. Primary numerical semantics are separately assessed, not inferred from schema legality.
primary_math_unique: The rectangle has height3*8=24 from its three stacked gray squares. Let large white side x. The bottom row consists of three white squares of equal height s, so all have side s and3s=x. Height also equals x+s. Thus x+x/3=24, x=18 and s=6 uniquely. False unit transfer8 to s gives x=3*8=24. The7 squares and all original gray hatching remain unchanged; equal color is no equal-length assertion.
task_specific_human_semantics: This numerical diagram asks for a side length. Gray semantic membership is supplied by the unchanged diagonal hatching; a thin red existing boundary does not recolor a square interior or introduce a new gray square. It supplies no additional premise that red sides are equal.
